# Active sessions for OpenCode

Switch between recent sessions across projects from the **OpenCode V2** sidebar.
The plugin shows up to five top-level, unarchived sessions updated in the last
48 hours, newest first. It reads from the connected server, including remote
servers.

## Install

Once published, add the package to the existing `plugins` array in
`~/.config/opencode/cli.json`:

```json
{ "plugins": ["@daoninc/opencode-active-sessions@0.1.0"] }
```

Requires OpenCode V2 (2.3.1 or later). This is a TUI-only package and ships
Solid-compiled JavaScript. If you're using the local `./plugins/active-sessions`
entry, replace it rather than running both copies. Run `/reload` if needed.

## Use

- The section starts collapsed, with the session count on the right. Click the
  heading to show or hide session titles and folders.
- The current session is highlighted. Click another session to open it.
- The list refreshes on session activity and every 20 seconds. Entries expire
  after 48 hours even between refreshes.
- The expanded or collapsed preference is kept for the life of the TUI.

Run `bun test` in this directory for the session filtering and folder-label
tests. MIT licensed; see `LICENSE`.
